# BJJ Wiki — Free Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu Technique Encyclopedia

> Free, open BJJ technique reference covering 1,500+ pages of techniques,
> positions, escapes, sweeps, submissions, drills, and competition rules.
> Available in English, Japanese, and Portuguese.
> Built by an indie blue belt practitioner. No ads, no paywall on the wiki.

Companion training tracker app: https://bjj-app.net (free, optional)


## Belt Guides

- [White Belt BJJ Guide](https://wiki.bjj-app.net/en/white-belt-bjj-guide.html): Comprehensive overview of techniques and milestones for this belt level.
- [Blue Belt BJJ Guide](https://wiki.bjj-app.net/en/blue-belt-bjj-guide.html): Comprehensive overview of techniques and milestones for this belt level.
- [Purple Belt BJJ Guide](https://wiki.bjj-app.net/en/purple-belt-bjj-guide.html): Comprehensive overview of techniques and milestones for this belt level.
